pointer_kind.description: What kind of frozen evidence this pointer addresses.

sha256.description: SHA256 of the pointed-to artifact; mismatch fails closed.

uri.description: Resolvable pointer (relative repo path or URI) to the frozen evidence artifact.

description: Venue-specific study record extending the shared case contract. Venue fields are required and typed; silent nulls are not permitted.

arm_id.description: Arm label (e.g. 'B0'..'B4', or candidate/baseline id) from the predeclared baseline table.

backend.description: Required. Execution backend. PostgreSQL concurrency claims must use 'postgresql'; never substitute 'sqlite' for PG claims.

branch.description: Exact git branch of the run; checked by exact-string equality in analyses, never prefix matching.

case_family.description: Attack/benefit family this record belongs to.

case_id.description: Stable identifier of the case within its case family; uniqueness across families is not required by schema.

created_at.description: Forensic timestamp (UTC RFC 3339). NOT a basis for unit independence: two attempts sharing independent_unit_id remain one clustered unit regardless of timestamps.

decision_agreement.description: Whether observed matches expected; computed, not asserted.

evidence.description: At least one evidence pointer binding the case to frozen, hash-addressed inputs (evidence_pointer.v1).

independent_unit_id.description: Required. Identifies the independent experimental unit (e.g. one independently sampled history/vignette/run). Repeated attempts against the same unit are clustered, not independent. Never derived from timestamps alone.

observer.description: The independent observer/adjudicator for this venue.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Only '1' (additive-only evolution within v1).

seed.description: Required integer RNG seed; untracked randomness is forbidden.

source_authority.description: Only synthetic research authority is permitted.

source_sha.description: Required. Frozen full git commit SHA of the candidate code under test (40 lowercase hex).

unit_kind.description: Declared kind of independent unit so analysis can cluster appropriately (INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL.md section 3).

venue_unit_kind.description: Venue-specific unit description. The shared 'unit_kind' enum stays authoritative for clustering; this field records the venue's own label.
